reasoning_content:
Now I get it. The Docker setup has each workspace as a named directory (`$WORKSPACE_DIR/jdbc/xplan.xml`). The docker-entrypoint script references each workspace directory. The workspaces must be extracted into named subdirectories, not merged flat.

Let me check the kubectl/docker-compose to see how the workspace is mounted, to get the canonical directory name.

The key insight: each `<workspace-name>` should be a directory under `DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT`, and the zip extracts to that directory. So I should have done:
- `xplan-manager-workspace.zip` -> `/opt/deegree/xplan-manager-workspace/`
- `xplan-services-wfs-workspace.zip` -> `/opt/deegree/xplan-services-wfs-workspace/`
- etc.

And webapp.properties maps webapp context path to workspace directory name.

Let me check the docker-compose / kubernetes to see how the workspaces are laid out. Let me look at the kubectl Dockerfile and any compose file.
